name: design-is
tagline_zh: 你的界面被迪特·拉姆斯十原则审视，结果不是空泛打分，而是直接生成改造计划——新做、精修或推翻，一步到位。
tagline_en: Your UI gets judged by Dieter Rams' 10 principles, then a /make-plan prompt for new, refine, or redesign—no vague.
desc_en: Audit a design against Dieter Rams' ten "Good design is..." principles, then hand off a /make-plan prompt for one of three outcomes — new design, refine design, or redesign. Use when the user says "audit this design", "design review", "check this UI against Rams", "is this UI good", "critique this design", "design audit", or asks for a critique that should lead to a plan.
why_zh: 它不啰嗦点评，而是把批评转成可执行的三种路径，让设计评审直接变成行动清单。
why_en: Turns critique into a concrete /make-plan prompt with three paths—new, refine, redesign—so review becomes action.
